caption:
When the trail turns into a steep, mud-slicked spine of the mountain, the gear ratios don't matter as much as the rhythm you set. Here, the landscape demands a quiet, steady effort; there are no crowds to lean on and no engine to hum you along. You are left with the sound of your own breath and the vast, green silence of the ridge. It is the kind of climb that strips away everything else, leaving you with nothing but the next few metres of earth.
